title: Claim a server
intro: Claiming a server creates its Lineup profile. Only servers you own, or where you have the Administrator or Manage Server permission, are listed.

list.title: Your servers
list.label: Servers you can manage
list.emptyBody: Only servers you own, or where you have the Administrator or Manage Server permission, appear here. If you just created one, refresh the list.
list.reauthTitle: Allow Lineup to read your servers
list.reauthBody: Your session comes from the Moddy dashboard and lacks this permission. Sign in again with Discord.

form.title: Server invitation
form.body: Paste an invitation link that never expires. It proves the server is yours and becomes the Join button on the profile.
form.label: Invitation link or code

errors.forbiddenHelp: If you just got these rights on Discord, read them again and the claim is retried.
